subject: Operator decisions: two offline drift checks as BLOCKING stages of make validate
activeForm: Wiring the injected-docs drift check into make validate

origin.evidence: grep -c 'run_stage check-injected-docs' Makefile  # 0: the drift check is not a validate stage

work_items: Card #14: on the operator's yes, add check-injected-docs to the validate driver as a BLOCKING stage and update every citation the insertion moves
Card #14: on the operator's separate yes, add check-alert-query-copies to the validate driver as a BLOCKING stage

description:
TWO DECISIONS OWED BY THE OPERATOR, each a separate yes or no. Both wire a stage into the same validate driver, so one run lands whichever are answered yes; a no closes that work item. The first follows.

DECISION 1, check-injected-docs. Card #8 recommends yes. Helios ruled the wiring must not land without the operator, because a BLOCKING stage changes every future commit in this repo.

WHAT EXISTS. scripts/injected-docs/injected-docs-check.sh checks AGENTS.md and the core docs with six rules: cited paths exist, file:NN citations land inside the file, the Lambda list matches src/lambdas/ both ways, the CloudWatch namespace table matches code and Terraform, cited make targets exist, and the anchored citations in scripts/injected-docs/anchors.tsv still say what the doc claims. `make check-injected-docs` runs it on demand. scripts/injected-docs/injected-docs-check.proof.sh proves 7 of 7 perturbations firing. The tree is clean.

THE MEASUREMENT. Nothing ran the checker between its writing and card #8, and in that time the injected docs accumulated 14 real drifts (13 at the base plus 1 that checking AGENTS.md surfaced). The checker also reported 3 false positives or defects. Card #8 fixed all of them. The false-positive rate on the current tree is 0. Record: specs/1401-deploy-gate-can-fail/doc-audit.md.

THE COST OF YES. A commit that moves an anchored line must update the citing doc and anchors.tsv in the same commit. Today the anchored files are Makefile, .pre-commit-config.yaml, infrastructure/terraform/main.tf, the two dedup.py files and update-agent-context.sh. The land gate runs make validate, so a card that drifts a citation cannot land until it fixes it.

IF YES. Add `run_stage check-injected-docs "injected docs" BLOCKING; \` to the validate driver in the Makefile. Inserted after the existing stages, it moves the lines AGENTS.md cites below it (Makefile:125, :139, :162), and the check itself names every citation to update. Run the proof harness in CI as well, so the checker cannot silently stop detecting.

IF NO. Close this card. The check stays manual, and CLEANUP-BOARD's injected-docs card records the decision.

DECISION 2, check-alert-query-copies (raised by card #10, which recommends yes). `make check-alert-query-copies` reports any tracked file outside specs/, cards/ and docs/archive/ that restates the security-alert query instead of naming `make check-security-alerts`. It is offline and deterministic, reported 0 findings over 1096 tracked files on 2026-10-10, and exits 2 rather than passing if it cannot see scripts/check_security_alerts.py. Record: specs/1402-prepush-alert-visibility/. Not part of this card: gating on `make check-security-alerts` itself, which needs network and reports FINDINGS until card #15 clears the Dependabot backlog.
